meta.modelBlurb: Rank each of the ten stats within FBS, drop each program’s single best and single worst percentile, average the other eight.

provenance.wins: Wins/losses/ties per season (CollegeFootballData 1936+ → data/staging/_staging_wins.csv). Pre-1936: for the ~31 programs the NCAA "FBS Records" book publishes an all-time line for, one source=ncaa row calibrated so the all-time official total matches the book (data/staging/_staging_wins_ncaa.csv); every other program uses 1869–1935 game logs. A tie counts as half a win.
provenance.championships: Title list, one row per (school, year); scope=national with selector AP/UPI/FWAA/NFF/USA + CFRA/HAF/NCF counts, "claim"/"not-claimed" do not (data/staging/_staging_championships.csv).
provenance.allAmericans: Every consensus All-America selection from the NCAA "Football Award Winners" record book, one row per player; unanimous flagged from 1924 (data/staging/_staging_all_americans.csv).
provenance.nflDraft: Every NFL and AFL draft pick by school, counted from a pro-football-reference per-year scrape, 1936–present (data/staging/_staging_nfl_draft_picks{,_afl}.csv → _staging_nfl_draft_success.csv). A player taken by both leagues counts once per league. 1995–present picks are carried from an older build pending a re-scrape with the college column; AFL selections currently cover 1960 only (1961–66 pending).

tierDescriptions.Blue Bloods: The undisputed top six programs. The data separates them clearly from the rest. Each backed by sustained excellence and national relevance across multiple eras.
tierDescriptions.Blue Blood Fringe: Squarely behind the undisputed six, yet clearly above the rest of the pack. Their histories carry too much weight to ignore, and the numbers place them firmly in the tier just below the inner circle.
tierDescriptions.Blue Blood Contenders: The next tier of contenders, where the path to the top is less defined. Each has the history and foundation to make a run at blue blood status, but needs additional decades of sustained success or a truly dominant era to close the gap.
tierDescriptions.National Powers: Programs the whole country knows, with real title history. The band runs from genuine current risers to powers coasting on an era two or three decades back.
tierDescriptions.National Brands: Recognisable names and real trophy cases, but a clear class break below the powers. Also where newer programs still accruing the cumulative totals land.
tierDescriptions.The Field: Everyone else — mostly regional followings and thin résumés, plus the young programs whose ceilings haven’t been tested by the counting stats.

granular.allAmericans: NCAA record-book per-player list for 109/136 programs; the rest (no consensus selections) use a summary count.
